edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: Derived from NIFC Breitkopf & Hartel first-edition encoding; corrected by complete both-staff model review against the exact Paderewski Polonaises PDF pp.28-33. Original acquired reference retained.

Derived corrections are separate; no scan redistributed.
verified_scope: canonical printed bars and repeat signs
constant dynamic levels and tempo words
omitted_or_unverified_scope: optional second-pass D4 grace in bar 25: preserved as a direction and variant metadata, not a required first-pass attack
corrections: Discard source bars 41-56, the written-out second pass of printed 25-40; restore the canonical repeat signs. Remove the conversion-only empty bar 0. Source 57-104 becomes printed 41-88.
Remove extra E2 from the opening A1/A2 octaves at printed 1/17/65/81 and extra A4 from the first C# octave in printed 3.
Restore D7/D6 half notes at 33/57 instead of a quarter note followed by a quarter rest; preserve sounding octave values under the scan octave lines.
Restore printed lower-staff runs and trill passages while preserving independent voices. Restore upper bass clef for the descending trill run in 48.
Preserve required written graces at 16/49/80; keep the optional second-pass 25 grace explicitly separate.
Restore scan-reviewed f/ff/fff levels, tempo words, key changes on both staves, repeat signs and beam grouping.
